Different animals have different capacities for novelty and this is a big part of animal husbandry and is the primary factor around modern zoo design. Dogs are an animal with a decent capacity for novelty so they are interested in things not related to survival and they will use their full repertoire of skills as exploration tools. The evolutionary benefits are very clear as random investigatons can lead to discovering new food sources and adaptive behaviors.
